title: Mentions of feared or repeated incidents
summary: The topic contains brief references to whether an incident happened, did not happen, or might happen, without enough context to determine a clear customer evaluation.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention incident frequency, near-misses, and fear about something similar happening, but the fragments are too incomplete to identify a specific vehicle issue or clear sentiment.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic lacks clear evaluative sentiment.
The fragments are very short and do not consistently identify the underlying issue or event being discussed.
One fragment refers to another vehicle catching fire rather than a confirmed event in the reviewed vehicle, which limits topic coherence.
